column1: # Revised at 16:45 after sitting 1 measured the real burn: 2.62 BZZ/broadcast hour on the uploader,
# 2.7x what the night was costed with. What is left in the chequebooks buys about 166 broadcast
# minutes above the reserve, so the two soaks planned for 240 and 180 become ONE of 120.
# ⭐ Sitting 1 (obs-default vs shipped, 8 arms, all ok) is COMPLETE and is not repeated here. Its
# result lives in the chain directory from 20260812-155429.
# 120 minutes at the shipping profile is still twelve times the longest broadcast this project has
# ever run, and it answers the whole of #89 except the four-hour figure itself: manifest growth on
# real segments, the targetduration ratchet in the wild, whether the read path degrades over hours,
# and eight chances at the fourteen-minute collapse.
